<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the current sample. The carbon_nmr_spectra tool returns the 13C NMR data for the sample, which includes peaks for aromatic carbons (typically 110‑160 ppm). By counting those peaks we can determine the aromatic carbon count.</thought>
<action>carbon_nmr_spectra</action>
